about_short_description.short_description: Breadcrumbs.io is a revenue acceleration platform that helps companies in rating and scoring current and potential customers.

product.name: Breadcrumbs Lead Scoring Platform
product.description: A platform that uses machine learning to create predictive lead scoring models by analyzing fit and activity data to prioritize leads and optimize revenue opportunities.

product.name: Breadcrumbs Copilot
product.description: An AI-assisted tool that automates the creation of lead scoring models by analyzing data and generating suggested models quickly with user control for customization.

product.name: Breadcrumbs HubSpot Integration
product.description: A seamless integration that connects Breadcrumbs lead scoring capabilities with HubSpot CRM data to enhance lead qualification and automate workflows.

product.name: Free Email Verifier
product.description: A tool that validates email addresses to improve data hygiene by checking deliverability and identifying invalid, disposable, or role-based emails.

product.name: Breadcrumbs Explore Analytics
product.description: A business intelligence feature that consolidates data from multiple sources to provide unified views, trend analysis, and deep insights into lead and customer behavior.
